crew.overview: When carefree Nyles and reluctant maid of honor Sarah have a chance encounter at a Palm Springs wedding, things get complicated when they find themselves unable to escape the venue, themselves, or each other.
crew.title: Palm Springs

details.biography: Matthew Compton is a writer and performer for the critically acclaimed duo Electric Guest. Matthew has also written for and performed alongside: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Cold War Kids, The Pierces, Cursive, Joyo Velarde, Flea, Adam Green, and Har Mar Superstar. He has also been the composer for "Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping”, SNL’s “MacGruber”, “Monumental” and “7 Days In Entebbe”.
details.name: Matthew Compton
